📦 **Sculpture `2de0d99e`** — feat(sculpture): add 1666 Fujian Ganzengchuan war junk (kotoko-ganzengchuan-01m, 31 works)

Add the complete sculpture family for the 1666 Fujian Ganzengchuan war junk
(`kotoko-ganzengchuan-01m-assembly` plus 30 `sub` child works), along with
parametric build/verification scripts, voxel masks, sail/flag textures,
inspection overlays, and handover reports under `design/`.

- Assembly specs: 384x192x384 canvas (`0.1 m/voxel`), 135,808 voxels,
  `components=1`, `cavities=0`, `link_overlap=0`, 62 models, 98 ropes
  (196/196 ends ok), 4 sails (fore/main hard-batten fan junk sails with 7+9
  battens, pennants/ensign).
- Internals & armament: hold/main/fore/poop decks, 3 ladders, 8x 4-pdr guns +
  4x swivel pierriers, powder magazine with 3-deck hoist (`ladders-1..3`),
  5-hole Chinese lifting rudder (2,628 vox) + articulated tiller (`±35 deg`),
  catheads + grapnel anchors, and 4 auxiliary sweep oars (`render=pole`).
- Verification: deterministic static/sweep collision checks clean; Blockside
  `shipcheck --id ganzengchuan` 0 errors / 0 warnings, `ladcheck` 3/3 ok.

Refs TASK-1314

👥 參與者：@kotoko

---

(Glossary/personas/kotoko.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
